role: sequential exposed mechanistic-synthetic development only; never validation, EPA test, primary, or confirmation
objective: Test whether the previously registered fixed-window per-user Huber weight budgets remove the remaining cumulative-identity slow-drift failure while preserving every original scientific margin.

development_history.v2_disposition: all four covariance-forcing candidates pass clean, hotspot, event and invariants but fail drift; no eligible candidate
development_history.base_choice_rule: lowest v2 worst normalized condition loss; development-informed and never represented as independent

inputs.reuse: byte-identical v2 prediction inputs; no world or transport regeneration
inputs.truth_use: separate scoring capability loaded only after all v3 candidate predictions for a job are written and hashed
inputs.exposure: same exposed v2 worlds reused for sequential development; no independence claim

controls.reuse_rule: verify every v2 result, prediction and manifest hash in the v3 source lock; never recompute an unchanged control
controls.same_information: all candidates and reused controls receive the identical v2 information fingerprint before a method ignores or reweights fields

selection_and_exit.rule: A budget is eligible only if every unchanged aggregate gate and every per-run invariant passes. Select at most one by minimum worst normalized condition loss, then smaller per-user budget, then lower runtime, then lexicographic ID.
selection_and_exit.no_feasible_candidate: Close v3 and retain all adverse outcomes; do not change budgets, cap, delta, lag, base covariance/forcing, gates, worlds, or controls within this family.
selection_and_exit.downstream: A v3 nomination may motivate a separately frozen validation protocol only; it cannot open EPA tests, primary, or confirmation.

runtime.resume: only missing hash-identical candidate predictions; no replacement seed
